transcript.rawText:
Coach: Before we start, what would feel like a win for you by the end of today?
Client: I want a plan I can actually follow. I keep starting and stopping.
Coach: What usually gets in the way?
Client: Work gets busy, and then I stay up late to catch up on life. I end up skipping breakfast and eating whatever is around.
Coach: So energy and routine are the big themes.
Client: Yeah. And my steps are low. I sit most of the day.
Coach: If we aimed for one change that feels doable this week, what would it be?
Client: I could walk after lunch. Even ten minutes.
Coach: Great. And sleep—what time are you usually in bed?
Client: Around 12:30. I want that closer to 11:30.
Coach: Let’s note that as a target. We’ll also track what makes it easier or harder.
Client: That sounds good. I like tracking if it’s simple.
Coach: We’ll keep it simple. Any injuries or limitations for walking?
Client: No injuries. Just low motivation.
Coach: Motivation often follows action. Let’s pick a minimum standard that counts as success.
Client: Ten minutes after lunch, three days.
Coach: Perfect.

[System note: Plan generation is still processing for this meeting in the prototype UI.]
